findings.title: test_files in the build_request context is asserted only through a separate build_context(review=True) call
findings.detail: test_build_request_declared_reviewer checks `ctx["test_files"]` on a context it builds itself with review=True hard-coded, so that line does not exercise build_request's `review=is_reviewer(...)` path. The path is still covered indirectly: the branch diff (`print('hi')`) has to appear in req.prompt, and the implementer test checks it is absent there, so a regression in is_reviewer routing would still fail. Putting `{{test_files}}` in the test template and asserting `tests/test_a.py` in req.prompt would pin test_files directly.

findings.title: No test for a reviewer declared in the user layer
findings.detail: test_is_reviewer covers a project-declared reviewer and a user-declared triager, but not a reviewer declared in the user personas dir. Such a reviewer should be true with a root and false without one.

findings.title: Shape checks under an invalid role are untested
findings.detail: As shipped says that with an invalid role, check_declared_keys reports the role error and still checks the shape of required/when. No test feeds an unknown role together with a malformed `when` or `required`, so that branch (the `role in CUSTOM_ROLES` guard) could change without any test failing.

findings.title: Whitespace-only when items are not exercised
findings.detail: The validator rejects whitespace-only strings (`v.strip()`), but the tests only try `''`. A case like `labels: ['  ']` would pin this.

findings.title: No automated check that queue.py, profiles.py and divergence.py are untouched
findings.detail: The test plan intends this to be checked with `git diff --stat main`, and the diff touches none of those files. Recorded here only for completeness.
